about: The expected output of every example under examples/, read by scripts/examples.py: the arguments and standard input of each case, run from the repository root, and its exact standard output, standard error and exit status. Rewrite after an intended change with: python3 scripts/examples.py check --update. A release copies these cases into the spec.json of its examples archive.
